question: Should this standalone telemetry and dashboard-health contract be accepted as the stable prerequisite API for https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674 before the dependent shard-workflow changes land?
rationale: The patch introduces durable storage, externally routed query surfaces, and dashboard severity semantics that define the operating contract for later automation; tests establish intended logic but cannot determine whether this is the preferred long-term product boundary.

options.title: Confirm the foundation after isolated proof
options.body: Require a redacted isolated Worker validation of write, terminal, query, watchdog, and health behavior, then review this contract as the prerequisite for the dependent PR.

options.title: Fold the contract into the dependent design review
options.body: Defer this standalone PR and decide the telemetry schema together with the final per-item shard protocol in the linked PR.

recommendation.title: Confirm the foundation after isolated proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted isolated Worker validation of write, terminal, query, watchdog, and health behavior, then review this contract as the prerequisite for the dependent PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns both the proposed observability foundation and the linked dependent shard design, making them the best available routing candidate for clarifying the intended contract.
